olivia: Quick ask - PMM needs a validated benchmark table for the launch blog. Can eng/runtime run a deterministic sweep we can cite? We need p50/p95, tokens/sec, and cost per 1M tokens. Also want a short reproducibility note.

sam: I can. Which models/variants/hw/seqs? Also confirm payloads and whether raw logs are required.

maria: Targets: model-redwood-7B (fp16), model-redwood-7B-gguf-int8, and an off-the-shelf 7B like vicuna-7b. Seqs: 64, 256, 512. Batches: 1 and 2. HW: a100-80gb only for the primary table. We'll run a g4dn comparison later if needed. We want raw logs + summarized CSV.

sam: I'll do smoke tonight (single run each) and full sweep Friday (5 runs per combo). Using marketing_scrubbed.csv on S3 and a uniform synthetic set for latency normalization. Putting the command in infra runbook.

bench-bot: job 1832456789-smoke created; queued on a100 cluster.

sam: Smoke finished. Quick numbers (seq256 batch1): redwood-7B fp16 p50 27ms p95 72ms tokens/sec 950 cost_per_1M $14. redwood-7B-gguf-int8 p50 23ms p95 80ms tokens/sec 1020 cost_per_1M $6. vicuna-7b fp16 p50 30ms p95 100ms tokens/sec 900 cost_per_1M $15. Raw logs at s3://redwood-marketing/bench-raw/1832456789/; commit: d4e5f6a; seed: 2026.

maria: Good. Please include a methodology blurb for the appendix and the one-liner smoke command for reproducibility.

sam: Method blurb: "Benchmarks measured on dedicated A100-80GB instances, median over 5 runs after a short warmup. See artifacts for full per-run traces and configs." One-liner: `python infra/bench/run_bench.py --model model-redwood-7B --variant fp16 --batch 1 --seq 256 --runs 50 --seed 2026 --hw a100-80gb --payloads <s3 path>`.

noah: PMM satisfied with the language. Please attach full-sweep artifacts when ready.

maria: Thanks all :tada:
